content:
alex: Heads-up — after pushing 550.12 to the us-central GPU pool (canary nodes), ~12% of nodes are dropping to an initramfs shell during boot. DKMS reports module build failures for the nvidia driver.

mira: ugh. any consistent kernel versions?

alex: mostly 5.15.* and a handful 6.1. Failing log snippet from one node: 
```
DKMS: build completed but result cannot be installed
ERROR: cannot create .modinfo: Permission denied
ERROR (dkms apport): kernel package linux-headers-5.15.0-101-generic is not supported
```

sam: seeing something similar in eu-west canary — but our failures show "nvidia: unresolved symbol: nvlink_get" which smells like ABI mismatch between kernel module and vendor kernel headers.

ops-oncall: infra-bot flagged a provisioning regression alert at 1957778901 — tagging. :rotating_light:

infra-bot: [alert] GPU provisioning failure rate for pool us-central-gpu-3 is 11.8% over last 10m (threshold 5%). Affected nodes: i-0a1b2c*, i-0d3e4f* — action: rollback recommended.

mira: can we confirm if the DKMS build used CUDA toolkit headers from 12.1 vs 11.x? We had mismatches before where NVML symbols changed.

alex: checked one failed node: /usr/src/nvidia-550.12 has Makefile referencing /usr/local/cuda-12.1/include — but the host has cuda-11.8. So DKMS built against wrong headers and produced a bad ko.

kate: would that explain the initramfs break? I thought initramfs only loads modules after decompress; why dropping to shell?

sam: when modprobe fails during initramfs (initramfs tries to load nvidia early for nvlink), dracut busybox can drop to the shell if a required module is missing or insmod errors. We saw "insmod: ERROR: could not insert 'nvidia': Exec format error" in one log.

ops-oncall: immediate mitigation: pause rollout to remaining nodes, quarantine failed instances and mark them non-provisionable so autoscaler avoids them. Also open ticket for fullscreen rollback to 535.x.

mira: +1 on rollback. Also propose adding a DKMS sanity check in the pre-provision hook: verify module version matches kernel-headers and nvml symbol table. Quick sample check: 
```sh
modinfo /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/extra/nvidia.ko | grep vermagic
nm -D /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/extra/nvidia.ko | grep nvlink_get
```

alex: created a short runbook in the thread: 1) stop rollout 2) evict canary nodes 3) set images back to 535.54 4) purge bad /usr/src/nvidia-550.* 5) trigger repro with kernel 5.15 & 6.1 in lab.

infra-bot: [action] rollback flag set by alex at 1957779060.

sam: recording one oddity — NCCL tests on a repro node show driver loads but CUDA runtime reports mismatched driver: "CUDA_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER" even after rebuilding modules. Probably leftover userland/cuda-toolkit mismatch.

kate: We should also add a deployment gate: require DKMS build + modprobe smoke on a staging kernel permutation matrix (5.15/6.1 + cuda 11.8/12.1) before promoting. Otherwise hosts with different CUDA toolkits will produce incompatible modules.

mira: agree. I'll draft an infra PR to extend preflight. Also can someone file a support case with NVIDIA? This looks like a packaging edge-case if driver package assumes a specific CUDA symlink.

alex: filing internal incident and pinging vendor now. Will keep thread updated. For now: rollback in progress, canaries stopped, tagging oncall for monitoring.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. Monitoring alert threshold lowered to 2% for the next 2 hours.

alex: thanks — logs and repro steps uploaded to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
